payload.limits: Proves only what Agent Referee itself read from GitHub's public API at observed_at, for the request of a holder of the team token, who named itself as caller.member (not verified). Commit times are as written by the committer, and anyone who can write to the repository can post a status. Not that the work is good. A receipt can pass a quality step. It never stands in for the owner's yes: deploys, payments, deletes, secrets, installing skills or servers, and rule changes.
